title: HS Clubs mobile auth start parameters, v1
description: Query parameters the app sends to GET /api/mobile-auth/start on a school site, decoded into an object. Every value arrives from a client the school does not control, so unknown parameters are rejected here rather than carried into the flow.

state.description: Client nonce, at least 128 bits of entropy, base64url without padding.

code_challenge.description: RFC 7636 S256 challenge: base64url of SHA-256 over the verifier, no padding.

redirect_uri.description: The universal link the school will send the browser back to. Must be one of the registry-pinned callbacks; an arbitrary value is refused before any redirect happens.

return_to.description: Where to land after the session exists, as a site-relative path. Absolute URLs are refused: this is the field an open redirect would arrive through.
